instruction: GUI-only requirement: Complete the task entirely in the opened Blender graphical user interface. Do not open Command Prompt, PowerShell, Terminal, or any shell; do not run Python, bpy scripts, Text Editor scripts, Geometry Nodes exported scripts, or blender --background automation that directly generates or edits the deliverable files. Do not install or run helper add-ons that auto-build the required result. Use only Blender native GUI tools, menus, editors, and built-in save/export commands. Ambient Occlusion Bake `scene.blend` contains mesh `Surface` and a 512x512 image datablock `AO_Bake` already prepared as the material's bake target. Bake ambient occlusion into `AO_Bake`, pack the image into the blend, and save the scene as `answer.blend`. Requirements: `AO_Bake` must remain a packed 512x512 image; the baked image must have mean gray in `[0.45, 0.90]`; the fraction of pixels below `0.3` must be in `[0.03, 0.35]`; and the image must not be flat, with gray-channel standard deviation at least `0.05`.
